<thought>Using the ESI mass spectrum, the base peak at m/z 183.045 corresponds to the protonated molecule [M+H]⁺. Subtracting the proton mass (1.007276 Da) gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈182.037 Da. The formula C₁₂H₆O₂ has an exact monoisotopic mass of 182.03678 Da, matching the observed mass within 1 mDa, and the isotopic pattern (≈10 % M+1) is consistent with ~12 carbons. Therefore the molecular formula is C12H6O2.</thought>
<final_answer>C12H6O2</final_answer>
